newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal's EDP prices to be set next week.
newsitem.headline: Portugal's EDP prices to be set next week.

text.p: The Portuguese cabinet was expected to set maximum and minimum prices next week in the privatisation of up to 49 percent of electricity company EDP-Electricidade de Portugal, a source close to the process said.
"The definition of prices in the sale of EDP should be set by cabinet on Thursday next week," said the source, who asked not to be identified.
There are no rules for setting the prices, but in previous privatisations of Portugal Telecom and Portucel Industrial, the minimum price was around 25 percent below the maximum price.
"After the start of the bookbuilding, and based on these price indications, the cabinet will set quantities to be sold in the public offer for sale (OPV) and the direct sale," the source said.
The price in the OPV will be fixed at a level between the maximum and minimum prices by Under-Secretary for Finance Fernando Teixeira Santos on June 16, the date of the OPV.
